name: Timer
description: API for creating and managing timers.

functions.name: setInterval
functions.description: Creates a timer which calls the function continuously with the given delay.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: The time between function calls (in seconds).

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: The function to call at each interval.

functions.name: setTimeout
functions.description: Creates a timer which calls the function once after the given delay.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: The delay before calling the function (in seconds).

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: The function to call after the timeout.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the timer to clear.
